# Interceptors — Evidence

<!-- Generated by `tyto-docs-engine build-evidence`. Do not edit. -->

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.a9c23c83"></a>**1. The unit backend/src/common/interceptors contains three NestJS interceptors — LoggingInterceptor, QueryTimeoutInterceptor, and RateLimitHeadersInterceptor — each an @Injectable() class implementing NestInterceptor.**
  [`logging.interceptor.ts:16-17`](../logging.interceptor.ts#L16-L17)
  [`query-timeout.interceptor.ts:11-12`](../query-timeout.interceptor.ts#L11-L12)
  [`rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts:19-20`](../rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts#L19-L20)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.30699c65"></a>**2. LoggingInterceptor is documented as adding a request ID and user ID to all log entries and logging request start and completion with timing information, using a Logger instance named 'HTTP'.**
  [`logging.interceptor.ts:12-18`](../logging.interceptor.ts#L12-L18)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.18251310"></a>**3. QueryTimeoutInterceptor is an @Injectable() class implementing NestInterceptor whose constructor accepts a timeoutMs value that defaults to 30000 milliseconds.**
  [`query-timeout.interceptor.ts:11-17`](../query-timeout.interceptor.ts#L11-L17)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.61a7a445"></a>**4. RateLimitHeadersInterceptor is an @Injectable() class implementing NestInterceptor that is documented as adding the X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers to responses.**
  [`rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts:11-22`](../rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts#L11-L22)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.0ce45ce6"></a>**5. QueryTimeoutInterceptor.intercept applies an rxjs timeout of timeoutMs to the response stream and converts a TimeoutError into a RequestTimeoutException with statusCode 408, message 'REQUEST_TIMEOUT', and an error describing the exceeded timeout in seconds; any other error is rethrown unchanged.**
  [`query-timeout.interceptor.ts:19-35`](../query-timeout.interceptor.ts#L19-L35)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.82c2bf04"></a>**6. The rateLimitInfo object that RateLimitHeadersInterceptor reads is attached to the response by CustomThrottlerGuard in backend/src/common/guards, which sets limit, remaining, and reset fields on it.**
  [`rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts:26-28`](../rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts#L26-L28)
  [`custom-throttler.guard.ts:46-51`](../../guards/custom-throttler.guard.ts#L46-L51)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.5d2a50a2"></a>**7. When rateLimitInfo is absent, RateLimitHeadersInterceptor falls back to reading 'throttle' metadata from the route handler via Reflect.getMetadata, setting X-RateLimit-Limit (default 100) and X-RateLimit-Reset (default now plus 60000 milliseconds) while omitting X-RateLimit-Remaining.**
  [`rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts:34-48`](../rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts#L34-L48)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.987da0ae"></a>**8. AppModule registers LoggingInterceptor as a global interceptor through the APP_INTERCEPTOR provider.**
  [`app.module.ts:43-47`](../../../app.module.ts#L43-L47)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.56665a46"></a>**9. main.ts registers QueryTimeoutInterceptor as a global interceptor with a 60000 millisecond timeout, commented as accommodating PDF parsing.**
  [`main.ts:69-70`](../../../main.ts#L69-L70)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.da60b4cd"></a>**10. The unit's index.ts barrel file re-exports the rate-limit-headers and query-timeout interceptors, but does not re-export the logging interceptor.**
  [`index.ts:1-2`](../index.ts#L1-L2)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.da54c6bb"></a>**11. LoggingInterceptor.intercept generates or reuses a request ID from the x-request-id request header (falling back to a uuidv4), stores it on the request as requestId, and sets it as the X-Request-ID response header.**
  [`logging.interceptor.ts:20-28`](../logging.interceptor.ts#L20-L28)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.b7b8ed8b"></a>**12. LoggingInterceptor extracts the user ID from request.user?.id, defaulting to 'anonymous', and stores it on the request as userId.**
  [`logging.interceptor.ts:30-32`](../logging.interceptor.ts#L30-L32)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.15edc3b0"></a>**13. LoggingInterceptor logs an 'Incoming request' entry containing the requestId, userId, method, url, ip, and user-agent of each request.**
  [`logging.interceptor.ts:34-45`](../logging.interceptor.ts#L34-L45)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.0237d7db"></a>**14. LoggingInterceptor taps the response stream to log 'Request completed' with the response statusCode and duration in milliseconds, and 'Request failed' with the error's status (defaulting to 500) and message.**
  [`logging.interceptor.ts:47-79`](../logging.interceptor.ts#L47-L79)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.f6a184f0"></a>**15. RateLimitHeadersInterceptor.intercept reads a rateLimitInfo object attached to the response by the throttler guard and, when present, sets the X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers from its limit, remaining, and reset fields.**
  [`rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts:24-33`](../rate-limit-headers.interceptor.ts#L24-L33)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-interceptors.c22ec7bf"></a>**16. The only repository files that import from this unit are backend/src/app.module.ts, which imports LoggingInterceptor, and backend/src/main.ts, which imports QueryTimeoutInterceptor.**
  [`app.module.ts:15-15`](../../../app.module.ts#L15-L15)
  [`main.ts:10-10`](../../../main.ts#L10-L10)
